paragraphs: Chananyah ben Yehudah. R. Yehudah said, “Chananyah ben Yehudah expounded all his days: ‘Anger is severe, for it caused Moses to err.’ I will respond to his words”: Sifra, Shemini, end of chapter 2. This is not Chana ben Yehudah; see there.
